source: profiled by tools/machine-profiler.py on linux, 2026-11-03; not curated
summary: Control machine (profiled draft): moves other machines' parameters; makes no sound.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: LFO cycle length in ticks (free-running mode). 16 ticks = 1 bar at 4 TPB. Ignored when Sync is set.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: Modulation amount, in % of target parameter range (peak-to-peak swing = Depth × range).

parameters.name: Center
parameters.description: Center value, in % of target parameter range. LFO oscillates around this point.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: Time base. Free uses Period; others lock one cycle to a musical division.

parameters.name: Bypass
parameters.description: Disable LFO output (target value frozen at last write)

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: Switch: 1 = LFO running (0→1 transition retriggers from phase 0). 0 = stopped, target held at Center.
